description.content: Use this endpoint for information on what multi-factor authentication challenges need to be answered in order to aggregate a member. If the aggregation is not challenged, i.e., the member does not have a connection status of `CHALLENGED`, then code `204 No Content` will be returned. If the aggregation has been challenged, i.e., the member does have a connection status of `CHALLENGED`, then code `200 OK` will be returned - along with the corresponding credentials.

response.name: OK
